newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London static ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London static ahead of holiday.

text.p: Japanese shares were little changed from Tokyo's closing levels on Wednesday as many participants stayed away ahead of a public holiday in Japan on Thursday.
The Tokyo financial markets are closed on Thursday in observance of the Vernal Equinox holiday.
"There has been very little business," one dealer said. "Some people think the (Tokyo share) market may slip on Friday after the bank holiday."
In Tokyo on Wednesday, shares ended slightly higher, continuing to benefit from government plans to breathe life into the domestic property market.
The Nikkei-225 index finished at 18,493.71, up 48.51 points.
